title: Reemployment Is Not Just Transition
summary: From a new job through equivalent or improved pay, hours, benefits, safety, voice, stability, skills use, family and place continuity, community recovery, and long-horizon security.
map_question: What records are required before reemployment is not just transition can support a bounded labor, livelihood, or economic-democracy decision?
interpretation_boundary: This map does not establish job availability, hiring, decent work, pay adequacy, safety, bargaining power, ownership, livelihood security, just transition, score, rank, or receipt.

Actual jobs, accessible matching, fair hiring, accommodation, and appeal
nodes.note: A job posting is not an available job.

what_this_map_supports: Separate actual-job, hiring, job-quality, safety, bargaining, ownership, livelihood, displacement, and just-transition decisions.
Explicit authority, workers, employers, households, communities, rights, distribution, uncertainty, challenge, enforcement, and review.
Public reasoning without worker, employer, household, community, region, or occupation scoring or ranking.
what_this_map_does_not_prove: It does not hire, classify, pay, schedule, discipline, recognize a union, bargain, transfer ownership, allocate benefits, relocate, reemploy, or decide a transition.
It does not convert postings, employment, wage rates, training, consultation, or reemployment into outcomes.
It does not create a receipt, score, rank, stage advance, or operating-outcome change.
next_records_needed: A verified Phase 87 human-development and public-knowledge chain with receipts.
